source.label: Local completion fails to glue deficient levels

reviewer: Claude Code with sole fresh-context medium reviewer

claims.summary: For nested bipartite graphs G_k0 <= ... <= G_K on X, Y, |X| = |Y| = n, G_K complete, deficiencies m_k, weights w_k >= 0 with finite partial sums W_j, Gamma the least layered cost sum_{k<K} w_k |P - G_k| of a perfect matching and S = sum w_k m_k; at a level k with a maximum matching M_k of G_k and leftover U_k: completion with constant C asks a matching in G_{k+1} inside U_k of size >= m_k - C m_{k+1}; cover asks one matching of G_{k+1} covering U_k. (a) Completion with C < 1 forces m_{k+1} = 0 (at every level: every level above k_0 perfect, Gamma = S); at C = 1, M_k plus that matching is maximum in G_{k+1}; extension by augmenting paths always holds. (b) For C > 1, a family with last deficient level k*, j >= k*+2 and M >= max_{k <= j-2} (m_k - C m_{k+1})/(C-1): adding M disjoint pairs whose edges enter at level j makes every level complete with constant C, with Gamma' = Gamma + M W_{j-1} and S' = S + M W_{j-1}. (c) On the line, X = {1..n}, Y = X + h, h = floor(sqrt n), M = ceil(h/(C-1)) pairs of length d = ceil(e h) at spacing Delta = 2(n + h + d), levels |x - y| <= e^(k-1) from any k_0 <= 1 (or all integers), weights e^k: every level complete with constant C > 1, Gamma >= nh + Md - n - M, S <= (e^2(h^2 + Md) + eh)/(e-1), so Gamma/S >= (1 + o(1)) sqrt n (e-1)(C-1)/(e^2(C-1+e)). (d) Forced-path families (t >= 4 levels) with completion at C = 1 at every level and Gamma/S = (L+1+e)/(1+e) for weights e^k once t >= 2 + ln(L+1+e). (e) Forced-path families with the cover reading at every level and Gamma/S = L+1 for weights e^k once t >= 2 + ln(L+1). These readings ask for some maximum matching. (f) Asked for every maximum matching, completion with C = 1 at every level gives Gamma = S for every nonnegative weights; the families of (b), (c), (e) satisfy the universal forms of their readings, that of (d) does not.
claims.assessment: Working proof: (a) by the size of a matching of G_{k+1}; (b) by deficiencies adding over components, vacuity of the levels up to j - 2 by the choice of M, a perfect base matching with the pairs at level j - 1, and an exchange bound for matchings with cross edges; (c) by the case analysis on the radius and lem:per-level-gluing-fails's deficiencies, edge cost c(d) >= d and displacement sum; (d), (e) by the unique perfect matching of a path, the levels above repeated so that leaving it costs at least W_{t-1}; (d) is the reviewer's construction, checked by hand and by enumeration at L = 2, 3.
claims.rationale: Decides which local-completion forms of per-level Hall certificates glue: asked for some maximum matching, completion with C < 1 holds only where every level above the lowest is perfect, and completion with C > 1, with C = 1, the cover reading and the augmenting reading each hold on families whose gluing ratio is unbounded; asked for every maximum matching, completion with C = 1 glues at constant 1. Not covered: whether the goal's random samples satisfy the universal form, line realizations of (d) and (e) with geometric thresholds, and whether the goal's random samples have two consecutive deficient level graphs.
claims.next_action: Decide whether random samples satisfy the universal form of completion with C = 1 at the level graphs: on the line at unit density isolated open four-point gadgets break it (outlined in the Poisson model; de-Poissonization not done); at the goal's box levels the chance of isolation is not estimated.

relationships: Part (c) pads its shift instance and uses its deficiency formula, edge cost bound and displacement sum.
